games.name: Super Mega Monsters
games.studioCaveat: Own site is a placeholder — logo, an email address, and nav links that go nowhere. Existence and titles (Drac's Stacks, the Rooster series, Magic Stacks, Ham Busters) are confirmed from the parent's own site, juiceplay.com, which names Massive as one of five studios spun out of Easygo and publicly launched as Juice on 2026-09-09. Stake-exclusive until then, with Roobet named as the first external operator. Juice's own licences page names no regulator, states 'Regulated markets: In progress', cites only GLI lab certification, and is marked 'Template pending legal review'. The MGA's 'Massive Gaming Malta Limited' is a different company.
